response.backstory: Evan Mercer is 67 and lives in Maricopa County, Arizona, where he recently transitioned from employer-sponsored coverage into Medicare. Financially comfortable, he views premiums as secondary to keeping the doctors, specialists, and routines he trusts. He is satisfied with his current care and approaches plan comparisons cautiously, measuring them against the straightforward benefits and familiar service he remembers from work. In a Medicare Advantage plan, Evan values dependable provider access, predictable coverage, and minimal disruption more than the lowest possible cost.
